limitations: Local trusted self-signed diagnostic identities; no Partner Center acquisition or Store certification.
Native file pickers and recovery-confirmation UI were not manually exercised; a real non-elevated window opened in every activation.
No new WACK run; older WACK records remain tied to their recorded packages.
No separate Windows account/clean machine, physical power-loss, actual host quota exhaustion or removable-device detachment test.
Synthetic ADF device controls and native CopperOS replays are separate results; optional other native media coverage is unavailable.
The frozen development guest assets remain unadmitted for shipping; no ROM, system image, private key or package was committed or published.
